description: This file contains unit tests for the MenuContent SwiftUI view in the OpenClaw project. It verifies that the view's body builds correctly across different connection modes and with various debug settings enabled.

classes.name: MenuContentSmokeTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the MenuContent view in different modes and configurations.

methods.name: menu content builds body local mode
methods.description: Test that the MenuContent view's body builds correctly when connection mode is local.

methods.name: menu content builds body remote mode
methods.description: Test that the MenuContent view's body builds correctly when connection mode is remote.

methods.name: menu content builds body unconfigured mode
methods.description: Test that the MenuContent view's body builds correctly when connection mode is unconfigured.

methods.name: menu content builds body with debug and canvas
methods.description: Test that the MenuContent view's body builds correctly with debug pane and canvas enabled.
